summary: A 'Flaire OS' parody desktop about business versus pleasure: a boot loader and a scripted Messenger chat with a demanding Creative Director open the site, then the page scrolls through draggable OS windows on a cloud wallpaper: an axis frame of three sliders, font-editor glyph views, '.gtdesign' ad mockups that a Flaire slider pushes from corporate to wild while critique stickers react, and closing windows for the shop, credits, a glyph 'Flaire Book' and an 'Encyclopedia of Minisites'. The tester is a full-screen overlay with sliders on three edges.

instances.look: Blurred pink-blue cloud wallpaper with desktop file icons (cartoon page with eyes, 'Amazing-Presentation-Very-Final-99f.design', an isometric floor plan) and a Messenger window where a 'Creative Director' sends messages ('Can you add more cowbells', 'Add more fun! More pizzazz! More flaire!', 'I need it now…'); below it a small orange 'No! I can't!' button and a big green 'Sure!' button in Flaire Extra; white taskbar 'Skip & Start · Messenger · 1:32 PM'
instances.ux: A 'Flaire OS' boot screen ('Initializing stuff… Loading font files… Adding cowbells… Extra Flaire…') with a rainbow 'GT Flaire' logo, then the chat types itself out; 'Sure!' or 'Skip & Start' scrolls into the page; 'Reboot' at the end replays it
instances.learn: Open with a scripted chat that states the font's premise as a client brief ('More flaire!'), and let the visitor answer with a button set in the expressive style

reconstruction.layout: Full viewport 1440×900. Messenger window ~400×470px at x≈215, y≈90 (title bar 'Messenger', avatar row, scrolling bubbles alternating left/right, 'Enter Message' field); buttons below it overlapping the window: 'No! I can't!' ~240×75px, 'Sure!' ~375×125px; desktop icons column at the right edge (~120px each with captions); taskbar 40px at the bottom with Start, app tab and clock
reconstruction.typography: Chat GT Flaire Basic (FLAR 0) ~24px, Creative Director lines purple, replies grey right-aligned, timestamps 10px; 'Sure!' GT Flaire Extra Black (FLAR 100, wght 1000) ~70px white; loader logo multicolour per letter; taskbar 13px
reconstruction.behaviour: Loader status lines step through; chat bubbles appear with typing indicator ('BOSS IS TYPING'); 'Sure!' grows; taskbar clock live; Lottie designer animation; windows draggable (data-draggable)
reconstruction.assets: Cloud wallpaper PNGs (blurred), desktop icon PNGs, Lottie scene

instances.look: 'There's / GT Flaire / in the air.' on three lines, each line in a different style (Basic Light purple, Extra Extra orange, Extra Light purple), then two purple paragraphs ('Typography is tension…', 'It reclaims an analog warmth…'), every line or paragraph tagged with a small outlined pill naming its style (GT FLAIRE BASIC MEDIUM, GT FLAIRE EXTRA MEDIUM)
instances.ux: static; vertical tab nav (Intro / Learn / Design / Facts / Test / Buy) at the left edge
instances.learn: Tag each line of the intro with the exact style it is set in: the opening copy becomes a labelled style sampler

reconstruction.layout: Left-aligned column from x≈100; headline lines ~200px tall, the middle line indented ~210px; paragraphs ~1150px wide, the second indented ~210px; style pill 8px above each element
reconstruction.typography: Headline ~220px: 'There's' FLAR 0 wght 300, 'GT Flaire' FLAR 100 wght 1000, 'in the air.' FLAR 100 wght 300; paragraphs ~64px FLAR 0 / 100 wght 500, leading ~1.1, purple; pills 10px uppercase in a 1px rounded outline
reconstruction.content: 'Typography is tension: precision on one side, expression on the other. GT Flaire captures this interplay…'

instances.look: An OS-window frame with a 'Flaire' slider along the top, a vertical 'Weight' slider on the left and a vertical 'Italic' slider on the right around orange office jargon ('Outstanding work on achieving this milestone!', 'Let's circle back on that'); then two stacks of card labels Light → Extra, purple (Basic) and orange (Extra), each card a step heavier, and a 'FAMILY SETUP' caption (7 weights × Basic/Extra + italics = 28 styles, 3 axes)
instances.ux: The three sliders move by themselves with scroll (keyframes) and can be dragged; the windows themselves are draggable
instances.learn: Put one slider on each edge of the sample, each labelled with its axis: the frame itself is the explanation of the design space

reconstruction.layout: Slider frame ~1240×800px: horizontal track 30px tall across the top, two vertical tracks 30px wide on the sides, sample centred; weight cards: two columns (~520px wide each), 7 overlapping white cards with drop shadow, each ~135px tall; caption 12px in a 450px column below
reconstruction.typography: Sample GT Flaire ~150px orange, driven by --font-flar 0–100, --font-wght 300–1000, --font-slnt 0–15; card words ~110px FLAR 0 (purple) vs FLAR 100 (orange) at wght 300…1000; UI labels 10px
reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] with data-keyframes (FLAR 0,0,100,100,0,0; wght 300,1000,1000,1000,300,300; slnt 0,0,0,15,15,0) interpolated over scroll progress; manual drag overrides; windows draggable
reconstruction.content: Office jargon: 'Outstanding work on achieving this milestone!', 'Let's circle back on that'

instances.look: Topic rows, each a purple headline sentence ('Flared shapes add warmth to the design.', 'Vertical terminals and their opened counters.', 'Reverse contrast activates negative space.', 'Sometimes being extra is just not enough.'), a huge glyph drawing in orange outline on pale grey ('Aa' with Bézier nodes, 'esca', 'nose'), a small tool window (View: Nodes / Fill / Outline; Pace; Contrast Basic ↔ Extra; Alternates with a pencil and vacuum-cleaner icon) and a caption headed in brackets [PHYSICS OF THE STROKE], [ANATOMY OF THE STROKE], [DYNAMICS OF THE STROKE], [THE BEAUTY OF DIVERSITY]
instances.feel: Inside a font editor, but cheerful
instances.ux: Lottie drawings play as you scroll; the View buttons jump the 'Aa' animation between node, filled and outline renderings (frame ranges); tool windows are draggable
instances.learn: Borrow font-editor views (nodes, fill, outline) as the explainer: the visitor sees the curve logic the caption talks about

reconstruction.layout: Each topic: headline ~1250px wide at top; drawing full width (~1240×520px); tool window 230×100px floating at left or right; caption column ~450px with a bracketed tag; ~1200px per topic
reconstruction.typography: Headlines GT Flaire Basic ~70px purple, leading 1.0; captions ~16px purple; tags 10px uppercase in a 1px box; glyph outlines 1px orange with square nodes
reconstruction.behaviour: Lottie players (A-all-three, esca, nose, meta) paused and scrubbed with scroll; View buttons play data-start-frame→data-end-frame (1–230 nodes, 239–450 fill, 462–680 outline)
reconstruction.content: Real design rationale: calligraphic pressure → FLAR axis, vertical terminals, reverse contrast in the Extra styles, alternates
reconstruction.assets: Lottie glyph animations, PNG tool icons

instances.look: White slogan cards between the design topics: 'Why settle for business when you can have pleasure?' and 'Expression or legibility? Why choose if you can have both.', green Basic words alternating with pink Extra italic words
instances.learn: Alternate the two personalities word by word inside one slogan: the contrast is the message

reconstruction.layout: Card ~1000×560px centred, light drop shadow, text centred in 4 lines
reconstruction.typography: GT Flaire Extra Black ~110px, leading 0.95; green #05ca6c roman (FLAR 0) vs pink #eb72ff italic Extra (FLAR 100, slnt 15)

instances.variantDefinition: Realistic layouts (ads, tickets, flyers) each paired with an axis slider that morphs the whole design from one end of the axis to the other, sometimes with reaction stickers that change with the value.
instances.look: Sky-blue grid 'desktop' with four '.gtdesign' file windows: a black lawyer ad 'Smith&Son's Advocacy — Trust.', a railway ticket 'Bern → Earth 12.12.2042 ¥589463.99', a 'basic store' discount flyer, a car-wash ad 'OPEN 24/7 EXIT 66'; under each a 'Flaire' slider with plain jeans at one end and flared trousers at the other; critique stickers ('Add More Flaire!', 'cringe?', 'N.O.', 'is that all?', 'omg') pile on
instances.ux: Drag the Flaire slider: the ad animates from sober Basic to over-the-top Extra and the sticker reactions change by state (meh → interesting → add more flaire → flairing amazing); file names mock version hell ('ticket-redesign-redo-v8-FINAL-final.gtdesign')
instances.learn: Let one axis slider rewrite a whole realistic layout, and add client reaction stickers: the visitor feels what the axis does to tone, not just to letters

reconstruction.layout: ~3450px tall section on a 20px light grid over clouds; windows staggered left/right: 500×700px (portrait ad), 800×460px (ticket), 430×500px (flyer), 720×360px (car wash); each with a 10px filename tab and a 600×70px slider window underneath
reconstruction.typography: Ad copy GT Flaire from Basic Regular (FLAR 0) to Extra Black (FLAR 100, wght 1000): 'Trust.' ~70px white; ticket numbers ~110px pink/white; stickers set in Extra, rotated ±10°
reconstruction.behaviour: Slider value scrubs a paused Lottie (ad-animation-*.json) and swaps sticker PNGs by threshold (state1 meh/boring/yawn, state2 aight/interesting, state3 add-more-flaire/good-job, state4 omg, state6 flairing-amazing); windows draggable
reconstruction.content: Fictional clients: law firm, railway, discount store, car wash
reconstruction.assets: Four Lottie ad animations, sticker PNGs, jeans icons for slider ends

instances.look: Over the cloud wallpaper, two large purple paragraphs tagged GT FLAIRE BASIC MEDIUM and GT FLAIRE EXTRA MEDIUM: 'GT Flaire bridges the worlds of business and pleasure. This typographic liberation is a hostile takeover…' and 'No longer bound to being strictly serious or purely playful…'
instances.learn: Set the same message in Basic then Extra one after the other so the reader compares the two personalities in running text

reconstruction.layout: Paragraph 1 from x≈100, ~1000px wide; paragraph 2 indented ~210px; style pill above each
reconstruction.typography: ~64px GT Flaire Medium, FLAR 0 then FLAR 100, purple, leading ~1.1

instances.look: 'GT Shop' browser window (address bar www.grillitype.com, '3kb/s' badge) with two link rows: 'Trial Fonts' → green/purple tiles TRY NOW / BUY LATER / TRY NOW, 'Buy all Fonts' → orange/black tiles BUY NOW / TRY LATER / BUY NOW, in Flaire Extra Black
instances.ux: Each row is one big link (trial fonts / shop); the word tiles cycle like a slow-loading banner
instances.learn: Make the CTA a parody banner ad: the joke earns the click instead of fighting banner blindness

reconstruction.layout: Window ~860×540px: grey address bar, then two rows; label column 120px left, 3×2 grid of word tiles (~250×110px each) per row
reconstruction.typography: Tiles GT Flaire Extra Black (FLAR 100, wght 1000) ~70px uppercase; labels ~22px
reconstruction.behaviour: Tiles swap words in a loop (TRY/BUY, NOW/LATER); 'Buy' also in the fixed nav
reconstruction.content: TRY NOW BUY LATER / BUY NOW TRY LATER

instances.look: 'Flaire Book' window: toolbar with Weight (flexed-arm icons), Flaire (straight vs flared jeans), Italic (upright vs tilted vacuum cleaner) sliders and an Alternates Off/On shoe toggle, then the set in grey: Basic A–z, Extended accented capitals, …
instances.ux: Icon buttons at each slider end step the axis down/up; hover a glyph to show it large in a zoom layer; Alternates toggle swaps to alternate forms
instances.learn: Use pictograms for slider ends (thin arm/strong arm, jeans/flares) so axis names need no explanation

reconstruction.layout: Draggable window ~860×1300px; toolbar row 70px with four control groups; glyph rows of 11 per line, ~70px pitch, category labels 9px
reconstruction.typography: Glyphs GT Flaire ~48px grey #6b6b6b, settable wght 300–1000, FLAR 0–100, slnt 0–15
reconstruction.behaviour: Range inputs and up/down buttons (data-direction, data-variable) set CSS vars on the set; char-set__zoom shows the hovered glyph; alternates toggle

instances.look: A 'Credits' window styled like an app About box (smiling blue-white 'I' mascot, 'GT Flaire v.1.01, October 29 2024', credits for typeface, site design, development, icons and copy) and an 'Encyclopedia of Minisites' window with a Wikipedia-like glyph globe and 19 GT families with years; final taskbar 'Reboot · GT Shop · Credits · Flaire Book · Site Explorer · 1:33 PM'

reconstruction.behaviour: Windows draggable; reboot screen overlay in neon text
reconstruction.content: Real credits (Reto Moser, Patrick Savolainen, Camp Quiet) and family list with release years

instances.look: Full-screen overlay (offscreen in the capture) with 'PER MY LAST EMAIL' fitted to the viewport (~235px) in green Extra Black, a Flaire slider window on the top edge, Weight on the left edge and Italic on the right edge, a Settings window (Shuffle mixer icon, Autoplay disco ball, Alternates shoe), a Close window (knives icon) and a Color window with 9 numbered swatches incl. a gradient

reconstruction.layout: Fixed overlay 100vw×100vh on a patterned background; sample fills the inner area (textFit); slider windows 30px thick pinned to top, left and right (draggable); Settings window top-left (x 80, y 100), Close top-right, Color bottom-left (3×3 swatches, 32px each)
reconstruction.typography: GT Flaire, sample auto-sized (~235px for 'PER MY LAST EMAIL'), leading 0.97, default wght 1000 FLAR 100 slnt 0, colour #05CA6C
